[NFCT.8.1] Full taxonomy in [NERR]. The codes the
assert path produces:

| Code | Cause |
|---|---|
| `DS_ERR_INVAL`               | NULL engine / schema, n_values mismatch, NULL string / JSON / fact-ref value |
| `DS_ERR_SLOT_TYPE_MISMATCH`  | value `kind` ≠ declared slot type; or a fact-ref whose schema ≠ the slot's `schema_ref`, or that names no live fact ([NFCT.2.3]) |
| `DS_ERR_OOM`                 | allocation failed |
